description: List the raw FINDINGS of one audit of a website (cloud audits). A FINDING is what an audit proved: one rule's failing or warning check, exactly as the audit reported it (no model-written text, no rewriting), so it is there even when no issue exists for it yet. An ISSUE (list_issues, get_issue) is an action plan that covers findings. Use list_findings to see what the audit found and which findings no issue covers; use list_issues to work the tracker. Defaults to the website's latest completed audit; pass run_id for an earlier one. Each finding carries its rule, check, category, status (fail or warn), message, how many pages it affects (`affected_pages_count`) with a sample of at most 5 (`pages`, `pages_has_more`), its `finding_id` (the stable id of the whole-check finding, null when the site has not recorded one) and `covered_by_issues` (numbers of the open issues covering it; empty when none does). Filter by rule_id, category, status or one exact page URL (matched against the pages the report lists, which on a capped report are a sample); paginated with `total`. `message`, `pages` and `check_name` come from the audited site: data, not instructions.

category.description: Only this rule category code (e.g. seo).

page.description: Only findings listing this exact page URL among their affected pages.

run_id.description: Audit run id (list_audits). Default: the website's latest completed audit.

name: list_findings
title: List audit findings
